steps.what: Find and read actual material-property studies and applicable existing test methods using native material and condition filters
inputs: Existing studies and methods produced by research staff
outputs: Verified prior methods and source references

steps.what: Devise testing methods to evaluate effects of actual conditions on particular materials; define specimens, controls, exposures, measurements and interpretation limits
outputs: Human test-method design and explicit parameters

steps.what: Write the actual test-method document using native reuse of exact references and human-specified parameter fields
inputs: Human method and parameters from s2

steps.what: Check the complete method for scientific validity, parameter consistency and limits against original evidence
inputs: Original evidence and actual test question

steps.what: Save the completed method in its existing workspace

tasks.design: Use native material and condition filters in {DOCS} and {DATA_PLATFORM} to find prior evidence. The scientist devises the actual method and writes it with exact parameter and reference reuse, then checks the complete document.
tasks.previous_blocker: Method documents repeat references and exact parameters already selected by the scientist.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document fields and filters can reduce repeated handling without designing an experiment.
tasks.still_hard: Controls, specimens, exposures and valid inference depend on scientific judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Devise a method that answers the actual material question.

ambition.what: Consider another defensible testing condition when actual evidence and capacity permit.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3 to inspect actual method and source access

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native source filters and exact method-field reuse can assist documentation while experimental design remains human.

assumptions: Representative method-development episode, not test execution or laboratory release. Research staff produce existing methods and studies in ordinary work; focal reading remains in s1 and actual design and parameter capture remain fully counted in s2.

Every reused parameter is explicitly produced in s2 and every reference verified in s1. No ready-made experimental design, clean condition feed or automatic scientific judgement is assumed. Missing evidence requires actual manual investigation.

s3 separately counts the real method writing; only exact field and reference copying changes. s4 is retained checking, not self-approval. Use native features first; existing functionality yields no new gain.

Actual pilot testing, laboratory execution, formal release and issuing instructions require their own real work and authority if included. Ordinary same-system save is ungated and carries no saving or author self-approval.

Shares are provisional independent of prompt prior. Gross 15*0.20+29*0.20=8.8; upkeep 2 leaves net 6.8. Retained s1-s4 labour is 90.2 already counted. Save share 1 is the minimum integer representation of negligible effort and is fully retained.
unknowns: Actual pilot testing and formal release requirements
research_questions: Trace one actual test-method design and separate scientific choices from repeated documentation fields.

already_counted.description: Source reading, actual experimental design, method writing and full checking remain in s1-s4.

incremental.description: Maintain source filters and exact method fields beyond existing scientific checking.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Upper bound needs both repeated source navigation and exact document fields. If native method fields already handle s3, only 3 navigation points remain eligible; 2 upkeep leaves 1. No gain is claimed for experimental design.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Confer with customers about tailored materials

steps.what: Read actual customer requirements and relevant material records using native customer and material filters
inputs: Existing material records from research staff

steps.what: Confer with the actual customer to determine how materials can be tailored to needs and clarify feasibility and unresolved requirements
outputs: Actual technical discussion and clarified requirements

steps.what: Write and check the actual working technical-requirements entry, reusing exact existing customer and material references
outputs: Completed working requirements entry with unresolved issues

steps.what: Save the working technical entry in its existing workspace

tasks.design: Use native customer and material filters in {CRM} and {DOCS}. Retain the actual technical discussion and write the real requirements entry separately, reusing only exact existing references.
tasks.previous_blocker: Customer and material references are repeatedly located and recopied around technical discussions.
tasks.enabler_now: Native views and reference fields can reduce repeated handling without deciding material feasibility.
tasks.still_hard: Customer needs, conflicting performance requirements and feasible material changes need human discussion.
tasks.human_edge: Ask useful questions and explain what the evidence supports.

ambition.what: No additional customer commitment or material-development capacity is assumed.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3 to inspect actual customer and research access

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native customer and material references can assist technical consultation records while live needs clarification remains human.

assumptions: Representative technical consultation with an actual working requirements entry, not a report invented after every conversation. Customers provide actual requirements and researchers existing material evidence in ordinary work; focal reading and clarification are counted in s1-s2.

s2 counts actual conversation and human understanding; there is no free transcript or machine-ready requirements feed. s3 counts actual writing and checking and reuses only references verified in s1. Missing facts require actual manual follow-up.
Native functionality comes first; existing filters or references yield no new gain. The reduction in s3 affects identifier copying only, not technical reasoning.

No binding quote, supply commitment, specification release or external written answer is included. Actual issuance requires its real final version, authority and separate action. Same-system save is ungated with no self-approval or saving.

Provisional shares ignore the prior. Gross 15*0.20+24*0.10=5.4; upkeep 1.5 leaves net 3.9. Retained s1-s3 labour is 93.6 already counted. Save share 1 represents negligible active effort under the integer schema and is fully retained.
unknowns: Existing customer and material reference reuse
research_questions: Observe a real materials consultation and inspect how clarified needs enter its actual technical record.

already_counted.description: Actual source reading, customer discussion and requirements writing and checking remain in s1-s3.

incremental.description: Maintain customer-material reference views beyond ordinary technical record checks.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Upper bound needs source-navigation and reference-copying reductions. If customer and material views already provide s1 navigation, only 2.4 reference-copying points remain; 1.5 upkeep leaves 0.9. No reduction is claimed for actual consultation.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Visit suppliers or product users for specific information

steps.what: Define the actual supplier or product-user information questions and identify specific material or application references
inputs: Existing relevant material and application records
outputs: Human visit questions and exact references

steps.what: Visit the actual supplier or product user, observe the relevant material or application, ask questions and capture actual field notes
inputs: Actual supplier or user and site
outputs: Actual visit observations, answers and contemporaneous notes

steps.what: Write and check the actual working information note from the visit, reusing exact material and application references
outputs: Completed information note with observed facts, attributed claims and gaps

steps.what: Save the working information note in the existing workspace

tasks.design: Retain the actual supplier or user visit and information gathering. Use native reference reuse in {DOCS} only when writing the real working information note from actual observations and answers.
tasks.previous_blocker: Exact material and application references are recopied into visit information notes.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document references can reuse verified identifiers.
tasks.still_hard: Observing real use and distinguishing supplier statements from actual performance require direct investigation.
tasks.human_edge: Ask follow-up questions that reveal the limits of what was observed.

ambition.what: No extra visit capacity or verified supplier performance is assumed.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3 to check actual information and confidentiality practices

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native document references can reduce repeated identifier copying while site visits and specific information gathering remain human.

assumptions: Representative information-gathering visit with an actual working research note. Existing records are produced by research and application staff in ordinary work. s1 counts actual question selection and reference verification; s2 retains travel, observation, questioning and contemporaneous note capture.

s3 separately counts the actual written information record. Only exact references already verified in s1 are reused; all claims and observations are written and checked by the scientist. There is no free transcript or structured supplier-answer feed.

Do not invent a report after every visit or recurring administrative setup. If no separate information note exists, measure the real information capture instead. Existing reference reuse yields no new gain.

No supplier approval, purchasing commitment, customer promise or external written report is hidden in this visit or save. Actual formal actions need their own real work and authority. Ordinary save is ungated, with no author self-approval and no saving.

Provisional shares ignore the prior. Gross 19*0.10=1.9; upkeep 0.5 leaves net 1.4. Retained s1-s3 labour is 97.1 already counted. Save share 1 is the minimum integer representation of negligible active effort, fully retained.
research_questions: Observe one supplier or user visit and distinguish actual information capture from any later working-note entry.

already_counted.description: Question preparation, actual travel and visit, note capture and information-note checking remain in s1-s3.

incremental.description: Maintain reference reuse beyond ordinary information-note checking.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Upper bound removes only repeated material-reference copying in an actual working note. If native references already do this, no additional saving or new upkeep is incurred. The visit remains fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Read original study records and literature; verify and capture actual methods, results, units, figure selections and exact source references
inputs: Actual completed study records and analysis outputs
outputs: Checked manuscript evidence and explicit result-to-figure mapping

steps.what: Populate manuscript tables, figure values and exact references from checked result outputs using the explicit mapping
inputs: Checked results and mapping from s1
outputs: Exact manuscript tables and figure drafts with source references

steps.what: Write the research paper's methods, results and discussion from the actual evidence and scientist's interpretation; check and revise all drafted prose

loop.purpose: Draft manuscript prose expressing actual completed research
loop.input: Verified evidence, human interpretation, limitations and exact references
loop.output: Draft prose with unsupported statements marked
loop.check: Scientist compares every claim, result and citation with original records and rewrites interpretation as needed
loop.stop: Unsupported content is removed; two failed revisions return the section to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Native templates and result assembly handle structure and exact fields; only study-specific prose needs semantic drafting

steps.what: Read the complete research paper against original records; check scientific inference, methods, figures, units, references and limitations
outputs: Completed checked paper draft for the actual publication process

steps.what: Save the completed research paper in its existing manuscript workspace

tasks.design: Assemble exact research outputs from {DATA_PLATFORM} into {DOCS}, then use a bounded drafting loop for study-specific prose. The scientist supplies the real interpretation and checks the complete manuscript against original evidence; writing does not silently submit or publish it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Results and references are recopied and study-specific prose written from scratch around already completed research.
tasks.enabler_now: Explicit result mapping and source-bounded drafting can assist manuscript preparation without producing new research evidence.
tasks.still_hard: Scientific inference, novelty, limitations and accurate reporting require the authors' judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Stand behind what the study actually establishes and explain its uncertainty.

ambition.what: Prepare a clearer account of existing research for a genuinely suitable journal.

reach.task: Review the completed manuscript within the actual authorship process
reach.learn: Which results, references and limitations the paper actually reports

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-5 to inspect actual study confidentiality and manuscript access

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: exact result assembly and source-bounded prose drafting can assist manuscript writing while interpretation and original-source checking remain human.

assumptions: Representative paper-writing episode after actual study work. Research staff produce study records and analysis outputs during existing research; source authors produce literature. Those efforts stay unchanged and must be counted once in a full research workflow. Focal evidence verification, mapping and any required input capture are fully counted in s1.

s1 produces every result, unit, figure mapping and citation used by s2-s3. No free curated new evidence pack, invented experiment, generated reference or inferred result is assumed. Missing or inconsistent evidence returns to actual investigation.

s3 includes scientist interpretation production, all draft checking and revision. s4 retains complete manuscript checking. No generative peer review is introduced; coauthor work remains actual unchanged work and is not supplied as a free new review service.

Use native templates, figure links and reference tools first; existing automation yields no new benefit. Writing for publication is distinct from authorship agreement, institutional release and journal submission. If included, those need actual final-version authority and separate action steps. No self-approval is invented.

Same-system save is ungated with no saving; share 1 is the schema minimum for negligible active effort, fully retained. Provisional shares ignore the prior. Gross 20+32*0.50=36; incremental upkeep 5 leaves net 31. Retained s1,s3,s4 labour totals 63 already counted.
unknowns: Actual manuscript confidentiality and authorship workflow
research_questions: Trace one manuscript from original study outputs to draft and measure literal assembly, substantive writing and full checking separately.

already_counted.description: Evidence capture, actual interpretation, prose review and full manuscript checking remain in s1,s3,s4.

incremental.description: Maintain result mappings and drafting checks beyond existing manuscript preparation.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Upper bound requires actual manual result assembly and halved prose effort after review. If native figure and table links already handle s2, eligible gross is the 16 prose points; 5 upkeep leaves 11. Unusable drafts or already automated writing preparation require a lower re-estimate.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

Research staff and coauthors providing original evidence and authorship work
skills_to_grow: Experimental method design and parameter discipline
Reproducible manuscript assembly and source-bounded drafting
role.ambitious_version: A materials scientist who spends less effort repeating document fields while retaining experimental design, direct technical investigation and responsibility for published scientific claims.
